2609.02293.title: SEAL: Reinforcing Global Safety in Mixture-of-Experts through Shared Expert ALignment
2609.02293.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a scaling architecture for large language models that activates only a small subset of expert modules per token, enabling massive parameter growth with nearly constant computation. Recent Hybrid MoE architecture adds \textit{shared experts} to capture consistently useful representations, further improving stability and generalization. MoE now powers many flagship open-source and commercial models, yet remains vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Specifically, sparse routing introduces a structural vulnerability: MoE safety hinges on which experts are activated, and adversaries can subvert this selection through jailbreak prompts, malicious fine-tuning, and weight-level pruning of safety-critical neurons. Existing defenses primarily focus on hardening the router, but an adversary may still manipulate or bypass the routing trajectory due to the routing process's nondeterministic nature, thereby collapsing the defense. To cope with this problem, we first identify theoretically and empirically that shared expert, an always-activated component containing a small proportion of safety-critical neurons, can overcome the uncertainty of sparsely activated routing path and serve as a router-independent anchor to enhance global safety alignment. Based on this insight, we propose SEAL, a training-time parameter-efficient defense that produces a plug-and-play adapter attached to shared expert, and SEAL++, a variant that adds an orthogonal constraint preserving pre-existing safety subspaces during training. We evaluate SEAL and SEAL++ across six attack scenarios that combine three adversarial inputs (harmful prompting, jailbreak, malicious fine-tuning) with and without neuron pruning. 2609.02293.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）是一種大型語言模型的擴展架構，僅在每個標記上啟動一小部分專家模塊，使得參數大幅增長的同時計算量幾乎保持不變。最近的混合 MoE 架構增加了 \textit{共享專家}，以捕捉一致有用的表示，進一步提高穩定性和泛化能力。MoE 現在驅動許多旗艦開源和商業模型，但仍然容易受到對抗性攻擊。具體而言，稀疏路由引入了一種結構性脆弱性：MoE 的安全性取決於哪些專家被啟動，而對手可以通過越獄提示、惡意微調和對安全關鍵神經元的權重修剪來顛覆這一選擇。現有的防禦主要集中在加固路由器上，但由於路由過程的非確定性性質，對手仍然可以操縱或繞過路由軌跡，從而使防禦崩潰。為了解決這個問題，我們首先理論上和實證上識別出共享專家，這是一個始終啟動的組件，包含少量安全關鍵神經元，可以克服稀疏啟動路由路徑的不確定性，並作為獨立於路由器的錨點來增強全球安全對齊。基於這一見解，我們提出了 SEAL，一種訓練時參數高效的防禦，產生一個附加於共享專家的即插即用適配器，以及 SEAL++，一種在訓練期間添加保持現有安全子空間的正交約束的變體。我們在六種攻擊場景中評估 SEAL 和 SEAL++，這些場景結合了三種對抗性輸入（有害提示、越獄、惡意微調），並且有和沒有神經元修剪。SEAL 將攻擊成功率（ASR）降低了最多 60\%，在五個基準平均值上，能力損失最多為 1.4\%。此外，SEAL 可以無縫集成到路由器級......
